ov: Twenty-nine species of long-legged wading birds with long, down-curved bills, which they use to probe mud for food, usually in groups. They nest in trees, often alongside spoonbills or herons.
rg: Wetlands, forests and plains of the Old and New Worlds.
df: Mostly crustaceans and other food found by probing mud.
fx: The African sacred ibis was linked to the god Thoth in ancient Egypt, but no longer lives in Egypt.
The Australian white ibis is a native bird, not an escaped Egyptian one, whatever the urban myth says.
notes: Group entry. The animals.js fact is confirmed: sacred in ancient Egypt (Thoth), and the Australian white ibis is called the bin chicken.
